headline: Commerce Commission Files Charges Against Air New Zealand Over Disruption Rights
summary: New Zealand's Commerce Commission filed charges against Air New Zealand, alleging the airline misled passengers about their compensation rights during flight disruptions.
why: Air New Zealand is the country's flag carrier, and regulatory enforcement actions regarding consumer rights can result in legal penalties and compliance costs.

impacts.name: Air New Zealand
impacts.why: The Commerce Commission filed charges against the airline for misleading consumers.
